lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, typically containing 4-5 visible nodes per column within the mid-lateral frame.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with circular blobs to form a grid-like matrix, where blobs act as high-intensity nodes along the vertical stripe trajectories.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal ridge is visible along the dorsal-lateral interface, characterized by a light-to-shadow transition gradient running the length of the visible upper flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized disruption of the typical spot-and-stripe pattern in the mid-lateral region, featuring a blurred intensity gradient and lack of defined blobs, highlighted by an external white arrow graphic.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a significantly higher density and smaller average diameter of high-luminance blobs compared to the patterning on the main lateral flank.
